  <p>Current Conversations offers an automatically generated view of where the lab's research themes are being discussed across research, policy, media and public commentary.</p>
  <div class="research-watch-disclosure" role="note" aria-label="Current Conversations automated discovery and non-endorsement disclosure">
    <p class="eyebrow">How to read this page</p>
    <p><strong>Current Conversations uses automated searches and AI-generated classification, grouping and summaries to identify recent material connected to the lab's research themes.</strong> Sources may include academic papers, policy reports, news, blogs, data tools and public posts. Items have not normally been reviewed by a member of the Cities and Climate Learning Lab, and inclusion does not imply endorsement. Coverage is selective and uneven, and summaries may contain errors or omit important context. Please consult the original sources.</p>
